Nadia: onboarding 'marlin-6b' from open repo. quick triage: int4 conversion passes smoke but we see headwise phase inversion on even heads -> alignment hiccups for longctx math.
Ethan: inversion? like sign flip in rotary application?
Nadia: exactly. model metadata 'rope_signs' is an array of 1/-1 per head. exporter docs vague. our loader defaulted to +1 for all -> even heads ended up inverted.
Maya: can you show the fix?
Nadia: patched loader to read 'rope_signs' and apply sign multiply:
```
signs = cfg.get('rope_signs', None)
if signs:
    model.apply_rope_signs(signs)
```
CI-bot: unit tests failing on new case: `test_rope_signs_roundtrip`
Nadia: missing test harness setup. Adding synthetic cfg with alternating signs and verifying output against small reference prompts.
EvalBot: small eval: fp16 rouge 40.1 / int4 pre-fix 37.6 / int4 post-fix 39.9. artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/marlin/1778889876.json
Ethan: good catch. add to onboarding checklist and exporter compatibility matrix.
Maya: also add a sanitizer: if rope_signs length != num_heads -> warn and fallback to +1.
Nadia: done in patch. will open PR with tests and note in docs.
